answer: Each identity stakes one timber pile in a dune crest for a 75-credit bond. A velvet tag on the pile links its key to the dune plot. Each epoch the holder reports settlement under load; an inspector remeasures it against the dune compaction chart and seizes the bond if the gap exceeds 3 percent, the velvet tag repeats, or one pile backs two claims. Fee one is 37, fee k is 37+8(k-1), fee 1000 is 8029; 1000 fakes pay 4,033,000 plus 75,000 bonded. A hired-pile ring fails: one hired pile cannot give two settlement reports under one velvet tag. A truthful holder pays 37 once, bond refunded.
